question.instructions: Is the customer asking for something other than a refund?

standard_answer.note:
用户说：
“I was charged twice for the same order. Can someone look into this?”

这里明确提出的动作是 look into this（调查/核查这个问题），而不是：
“Please refund the duplicate charge.”

所以题目问：
“Is the customer asking for something other than a refund?”

从字面上看，答案是 Yes——客户明确要求了“调查”，这属于退款以外的事情。
